title: luscombeu/utrannotation pipeline - params.input schema
description: Schema for the file provided with params.input: one row per genome annotation

id.errorMessage: Annotation id must be provided and may contain only letters, digits, '_', '-' and '.'

genome.errorMessage: Genome FASTA must be provided, cannot contain spaces and must end in .fa, .fasta or .fna (optionally .gz). Relative paths are resolved against the samplesheet's directory.

annotation.errorMessage: Annotation must be a GFF3 ending in .gff or .gff3 (optionally .gz), without spaces. Relative paths are resolved against the samplesheet's directory.

tss.errorMessage: tss must be a luscombeu/cagescan results directory (containing tss_clusters/) or an uncompressed BED file of TSS clusters, without spaces. Relative paths are resolved against the samplesheet's directory.

tss_sl.errorMessage: tss_sl must be an uncompressed BED file (.bed) of SL trans-splice acceptor clusters (only with BED input in tss).
